sentences.text: The Common blackbird belongs to the group of birds and has a wingspan of 36 cm.
In Mainz-Bingen, 6009 reports were recorded over ten years, with main time throughout the year.
It is an omnivore and its habitat is forest, on the ground.
It has been recorded eating Hawthorn, Rowan, Elder and Guelder Rose.
It is active by day and is a resident.
Offspring mature at 365 days, and in the wild it can live up to 21.8 years.
